name: [P1] Neo4j Cluster Member Unreachable
message: CRITICAL: Neo4j cluster has unreachable members. Quorum at risk. Check {{host.name}}. See runbook: https://github.com/Syed-Abdul-Rehman-Nasir/neo4j-enterprise/blob/main/admin/troubleshooting_runbook.md @pagerduty-neo4j-oncall

options.escalation_message: Cluster members still unreachable. Escalate to Neo4j on-call and verify quorum before schema or failover operations.

name: [P2] Neo4j Query Latency p95 High
message: WARNING: Query latency p95 exceeds threshold (warn 2s / critical 5s). Run CALL dbms.listQueries() to identify slow queries. Check for missing indexes. See runbook: https://github.com/Syed-Abdul-Rehman-Nasir/neo4j-enterprise/blob/main/admin/troubleshooting_runbook.md

name: [P2] Neo4j Heap Utilization Critical
message: WARNING: JVM heap above threshold (warn 80% / critical 90%). GC pressure likely. Check for large in-memory traversals. Do not restart without capturing thread dump. See runbook: https://github.com/Syed-Abdul-Rehman-Nasir/neo4j-enterprise/blob/main/admin/troubleshooting_runbook.md

name: [P2] Neo4j Page Cache Hit Ratio Degraded
message: WARNING: Page cache hit ratio below threshold (warn <97% / critical <95%). Working set may exceed cache size. Kill reporting queries and investigate recent data imports. See runbook: https://github.com/Syed-Abdul-Rehman-Nasir/neo4j-enterprise/blob/main/admin/troubleshooting_runbook.md

name: [P3] Neo4j Disk Usage High
message: WARNING: Disk above threshold (warn 70% / critical 80%) on Neo4j host. Check transaction log accumulation. Verify backups are running (logs prune only after checkpoint). See runbook: https://github.com/Syed-Abdul-Rehman-Nasir/neo4j-enterprise/blob/main/admin/troubleshooting_runbook.md

name: Neo4j Replication Lag High
message: WARNING: Raft replication lag exceeds 30s on {{host.name}}. Secondary is falling behind primary. Check network between cluster members and disk I/O on secondary. See runbook: https://github.com/Syed-Abdul-Rehman-Nasir/neo4j-enterprise/blob/main/admin/troubleshooting_runbook.md @pagerduty-neo4j-oncall
